## Current teaching

At the University of Cantabria, I teach courses in economics and quantitative methods, including:

- **Redistributive Economic Policies** — B.Sc. in Economics (2026–present).
- **Financial Mathematics** — B.Sc. in Economics and Business Administration (2026–present).
- **Economics of Social Expenditure** — B.Sc. in Economics (2026–present).

## Selected previous teaching

- Statistical Methods in Economics and Business, including an English-taught international programme (2018–2026).
- Statistics I and II (2024–2026).
- Mathematics for Economists (2024–2025).
- Public Economics (2023–2024).
- European Economic Integration (2020–2023).
- European Economic Policy (2020–2021).
- Foreign Trade Techniques (2022–2023).
- Financial Mathematics / Mathematics of Finance (2018–2025).

## Supervision

I have supervised undergraduate theses on economic inequality, social expenditure, labour productivity, housing affordability, public policy and related topics. A detailed list appears in my [CV](assets/Javier_Lera_CV.pdf).
